cases.description: I don't think appending all ranges together here is correct when checking the text, since these could be distinct sentences separated by text in other languages; this might lead to e.g. false positives from text-level rules.

evidence.thread_resolution: SteVio89: You are right. As this should not run (the parameter MultiLangEnabled is not used now), I will remove this part.
